messages:
maya: starting a staged rollout for v3.3.0 -> initial 3% now, plan -> 3,7,15 over 40m. change window tonight 23:30-00:30 PT. targeting default + edge-eu. deploy-bot: rollout started id=r-4590, steps=[3,7,15], current_percent=3, details=https://deploy.internal/r/4590 :rocket:
noah_release: pushing short release notes (summary + migration hints) to #release-notes. tagging the runtime and metrics dashboards.
olivia_sre: quick flag: eu-west-1 p95 increased ~95ms vs baseline in last 7m. small sample (n=36). not yet an alert but worth watching.
priya_ops: can you attach the trace sample? want to check whether kvcache misses line up with spikes.
olivia_sre: sample attached: `trace-id: ab12c...` also query: `SELECT p95, count(*) FROM traces WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND version='v3.3.0' AND ts > now()-10m GROUP BY bucket(1m)`
priya_ops: correlating with infra: two containers on gcp-eu-02 had short OOM-kills then restarted ~2m ago. might explain the tail latency.
maya: hmm. options: 1) pause at 3% and pin eu-west to v3.2.3, 2) continue ramp to 7% but exclude edge-eu, 3) rollback v3.3.0 entirely.
noah_release: my preference: pause and pin eu-west; let other regions continue after excluding problematic hosts. we can coordinate a canary warmup and cache prefill before resuming.
olivia_sre: +1 pause & regional pin.
priya_ops: +1. I'll cordon off gcp-eu-02 and run prefill jobs.
maya: quick poll: +1 pause+pin, -1 continue to 7%, -2 rollback.
noah_release: +1.
olivia_sre: +1.
priya_ops: +1.
maya: consensus = pause. executing now. deploy-bot: pausing rollout r-4590 at percent=3, paused_by=maya, reason="eu-west p95 bump + infra restarts", action_id=pauser-4590
deploy-bot: region pin applied: eu-west-1 -> v3.2.3. traffic for that region diverted to pinned version.
priya_ops: scheduling warmup & kvcache prefill on gcp-eu-02. will report back in 15m.
olivia_sre: watching p95 and 5xx; will escalate if 5xx > 1% or p95 > 200ms for >5m.
noah_release: updating release notes with hold + region pin + mitigation steps. adding a note to changelog that v3.3.0 includes a new batching heuristic that can increase memory transiently on small machines.
maya: thanks team. will reconvene at +20m to decide resume vs rollback. ping me in thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout r-4590 status=paused, paused_at=4590012368, paused_by=maya, paused_reason="eu-west infra restarts"
maya: end-of-thread 1  holding until warmup results.
